plugins.name: zeroguess
plugins.description: Stops your agent from guessing. When a request is ambiguous, it asks multiple-choice questions round after round until nothing is left to guess. Clear requests go straight through.

plugins.name: zerogap
plugins.description: Stops you guessing whether you know it. Quizzes you one question at a time, says plainly what was wrong and why, and stops when you've got it.
